name: SMS via Twilio
description: SMS messaging via Twilio. Provides send function, broadcast capability, and delivery logging.

envVars.name: TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER
envVars.description: Twilio phone number to send from

dbTables.name: sms_log
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sms_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, to_number TEXT NOT NULL, from_number TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, twilio_sid TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'sent', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sms_log_to ON sms_log(to_number, created_at DESC)
